newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Guerrillas in Lebanon wound 3 Israeli soldiers.
newsitem.headline: Guerrillas in Lebanon wound 3 Israeli soldiers.

text.p: Guerrillas fired on an Israeli army post in south Lebanon, lightly injuring three soldiers on Sunday, security sources said.
It happened at the Sojoud army post where two Israeli soldiers were lightly wounded last week in an attack by guerrillas of the Iranian-backed Hizbollah (Party of God).
Israeli warplanes followed that attack with raids on Hizbollah targets.
Hizbollah is fighting Israel and its militia allies in the South Lebanon Army in an Israeli occupation zone set up in 1985 to ward off guerrilla raids on northern Israel.
On Thursday, guerrillas set off a roadside bomb near an South Lebanon Army (SLA) patrol in the zone, wounding three militiamen.
